title: Choose the visual world for KKN Travels
question: Nine luxury-minimal designs built on famous destinations, no aircraft. Pick one, or type a steer.

options.label: 1. Grand Tour
options.thesis: Light and editorial: stone white, a refined serif, and three tall destination photographs in a staggered row.
options.viewport: Serif headline at left; Santorini, Paris and the Maldives as three tall staggered photographs at right; services on a hairline row beneath.
options.risk: Understated; depends on consistently good photography.

options.label: 2. Santorini Dusk
options.thesis: Dark and cinematic: one full-screen destination at blue hour, a fine serif headline and a slim glass enquiry bar.
options.viewport: Santorini at dusk fills the screen; headline in the dark space at left; glass enquiry bar along the bottom.
options.risk: Dark with a champagne accent sits close to the navy-and-gold habit of Dubai agencies.

options.label: 3. Atlas Mosaic
options.thesis: Bright and corporate: white, deep navy type, and a tidy mosaic of six destinations.
options.viewport: Navy headline at left; Dubai, Paris, Istanbul, Maldives, London and Makkah in a mosaic at right; five services along the bottom.
options.risk: Clean and safe; the least distinctive mood of the set.

options.label: 4. Gallery Wall
options.thesis: Warm and layered: destination photographs overlapping like fine prints, with real depth and a light sans.
options.viewport: Light headline at left; four overlapping prints at right (Alps, Istanbul, Bali, Dubai); a white enquiry bar along the bottom.
options.risk: The layered prints need care on phones, where they must stack cleanly.

options.label: 5. Emerald Journey
options.thesis: A solid deep-emerald panel with cream serif type beside a full-height destination photograph, joined by the enquiry card.
options.viewport: Left half emerald with the headline in cream; right half the Amalfi Coast; a cream enquiry card straddles the seam.
options.risk: Green and brass is rich and distinctive, but leans club-like rather than corporate.

options.label: 6. Lagoon Glass
options.thesis: Bright and fresh: a Maldives lagoon from above, sapphire type and a frosted-glass enquiry card.
options.viewport: Turquoise lagoon fills the screen; navy headline at left; glass enquiry card at right; five services along the bottom.
options.risk: Reads strongly as holidays; visas and paperwork need the copy to carry them.

options.label: 7. Golden Hour
options.thesis: Warm and open: a landmark at sunrise under a huge calm sky, a centred light headline and one floating enquiry bar.
options.viewport: The Taj Mahal at sunrise in the lower half; the headline centred in the sky; a white enquiry bar floating at the bottom.
options.risk: One landmark sets the whole tone; the image would rotate between destinations.

options.label: 8. Monochrome
options.thesis: Black, white and nothing else: an oversized serif headline edge to edge and black-and-white destination photography.
options.viewport: Headline across the full width; beneath it the Eiffel Tower in black and white, a text column, and a quiet list of services.
options.risk: Severe and fashion-led; some visitors may find it cold for a service desk.

options.label: 9. Panorama
options.thesis: Polished corporate: a strip of five destinations side by side, then headline and a six-service index on oyster grey with burgundy.
options.viewport: Dubai, Istanbul, Paris, Maldives and Makkah as five tall slices across the top; headline at left and six services at right below.
options.risk: Burgundy and grey will remind some people of a well-known Gulf airline.
